title: devx-sdk-daily-scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - SDK docs & sample apps (Devon)

Top priorities (today):
- [ ] Finish streaming example for JS quickstart (needs small buf flush note)
  - blocker: unclear which server-side snippet to show for token streaming (see GH PR #108)
  - expected ~1.5h
- [ ] Add function calling example (Python) to guided tutorial
  - missing: structured output schema example, show how to parse function args
  - link to Linear ticket: DOCS-457
- [ ] Update sample app README (react-chat-sample) to use new SDK auth flow (api key -> session)
  - change: move from local env var example to .env.local + note about CORS for hosted API

Quick notes / fragments:
- JS streaming: show both response.body.getReader() example and SDK stream helper: sdk.stream(chat)
- Python snippet for function calling:
  - show def handle_function_call(name, args):
  - lightweight example to transform model output -> typed dict
- Short checklist for PR review:
  - add unit test for sample app startup (ci: yarn test:smoke)
  - lint markdown with docs-lint
  - verify code blocks have language tags

Backlog items (low priority):
- rework embeddings guide to include batching example (batch size 32) + throughput notes
- add note about Dedicated quantized models (link to infra playbook)
- short explainer on cost tradeoffs: caching vs batching for web use-cases

Open questions / decisions:
- should quickstart default to hosted API or Dedicated for 'getting started' flow? (we used hosted in last draft)
- do we add a separate tutorial for private deployments? probably a short appendix only

Meetings / follow-ups:
- Pair with Sam to finalize streaming code sample (scheduled 2026-03-05 10:00)
- Ask infra team (Mikaela) about recommended kernel flags for mac M1 testing

TODOs today (timebox):
- 09:00 - triage PRs and reply to reviewers (30m)
- 09:30 - implement streaming example edits (1.5h)
- 11:30 - small sync w/ Sam (30m)
- afternoon - function-calling Python example + update README (2h)

Notes to self:
- Keep examples minimal; point to full sample app repo for deeper dive
- Remember to add a short 'what changed' blurb on top of updated quickstart (for changelog)

Links / references:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/108
- Linear/DOCS ticket: DOCS-457
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/DX/SDK+Quickstart

Random todo: ping @rachael about localization of strings in sample app

End of scratchpad.
